subtitle: Tier 3 Final — 12 cumulative questions covering lessons 22-29. Pass with 10/12 to unlock Tier 4 (Advanced).

blocks.title: About this final
blocks.content:
Tier 3 covered the 8 most important indicators with the regime-aware framework that makes them useful. The final tests whether you can apply them correctly — most retail uses indicators wrong because they ignore context. This quiz checks the context-aware approach.

Pass threshold: 10/12 required.

rows: Dynamic S/R + trend filter. 200 SMA = macro regime. EMA/SMA + period selection matters.
Regime-aware (not universal 30/70). Failure swings + divergences > single touches.
Histogram > signal line crosses (lags). Divergences with confirmation = strong signal.
Squeeze = expansion coming. Mean reversion in ranges only; band touches normal in trends.
Volume = participation = truth-teller. VWAP = institutional fair value, dynamic S/R.
ADX = regime filter (trend vs range). Stoch catches pullback extremes RSI misses in trends.
0.5 + 0.618 most important. Works through confluence with other S/R, not standalone.
Volatility-aware SL sizing. 1.5× ATR default. Adapts to assets and regimes automatically.

blocks.content: If you pass at 10/12, Tier 4 (Advanced) unlocks — order flow, liquidations, Wyckoff, Smart Money Concepts, multi-exchange divergence, funding-rate sentiment.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.content: Tier 3 themes that show up across questions: regime-awareness, confluence stacking, indicators as confirmation (not standalone signals), HTF context. Scan the lesson headlines one more time and click 'Take the quiz' when ready.
